heading: `float`
text:
### `float` [LCAP.2.9]

A construct capability. `float: true` permits the `Float` type.
`float: false` forbids every construct whose type, or the type of any of
its operands, is `Float`: a `Float` slot, literal, `let`, `const` or cast
target, and every operator, builtin and series aggregation that produces a
`Float`. The compiler rejects each with `DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED`
([LDIA.3.4.2]). What remains is exact integer arithmetic, logic, facts,
time, strings and regex.

A runtime may be built without floating point, and with it the float half
of the engine's arithmetic ([LCAP.1]). Such a build refuses an artefact
whose `requires` lists `float` ([RDSC.16.2.7]).
